canonical.title: Minimum Sum Partition
canonical.sourceFilePath: 14. Dynamic Programming/4. DP on Subsequences/03. Minimum Sum Partition.cpp

narrative.title: The Load-Balancing Forklift Split
narrative.scenario: A warehouse must load two trucks from one pallet queue, and the dispatch rule says the two loads should weigh as nearly the same as possible — perfect balance is rarely reachable. The scheduler therefore hunts for the split with the smallest gap between truck weights. Every pallet must go on one truck or the other.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer n and an array arr of n non-negative integers.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the minimum possible |sum(S1) - sum(S2)| over all partitions of arr into two sets.

testCases.explanation: Sides {1, 5, 6} = 12 and {11} = 11 leave a gap of 1.

hintLevels: Level 1: One side's sum s forces the other to total - s; small s means small gap.
Level 2: Run the reachability table up to the total, then take min |total - 2s| over reachable s.
Level 3: Only s up to total/2 need scanning, since the gap is symmetric around the midpoint.
